rules.statement: The failure to challenge evidence by cross-examination may be a factor to be taken into account in accepting such evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: However, in MMBL Teas (Pvt) Ltd. v. British Ceylon Produce Export (Pvt) Ltd. [S.C. Case No. SC/CHC/35/2008, S.C.M. 17.12.2021] Aluwihare, PC, J., (at page 17) was of the view that failure to challenge evidence by cross examination by itself may not be sufficient to hold that a particular fact had been proved within the meaning of Section 3 of the Evidence Ordinance. It might, however, be a factor to be taken into account in accepting such evidence.
